analysis: The supplied units are the head text of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1-202 and 203 onward). This is documentation only, with no executable code, config or wire changes in the reviewed text, so I found no concrete security regression. Several entries describe behavior changes that sit near existing threat-model areas, but the changelog is not evidence of source behavior and the underlying source files were not supplied: Autopilot, App Attest protocol 3 only (TB-011, T-052..T-058), cache routing persistence, SSD prefix cache TTL 30 min and write budget 750 GB/day (T-041, SEC-035), removal of the unauthenticated provider earnings endpoint (T-031), Stripe payout migration (TB-008, T-030) and the unauthenticated telemetry route removal. The 30-minute TTL is already recorded in T-041 as the SEC-035 re-acceptance. The cache routing persistence entry says it persists holders and demand without raw prompts or chain hashes; the actual source is unexamined, so coverage is limited. The changelog also notes that the advisory PR review workflow executes only the trusted base revision and keeps paid scanning disabled by default. The claims in these entries still need verification against the real code. No finding is raised, because nothing visible in the changelog contradicts the threat model.
